cutList.label: Rear leg
cuts: Mitre the west end: from 7/16" in along the south edge to the north-west corner (≈16.5° off square).
Mitre the east end: from 7/16" in along the north edge to the south-east corner (≈16.5° off square).
cutList.derivation: Each rear leg rakes back 7" over 24": d = (-7, 0, 24) in, 7^2 + 24^2 = 25^2, 25" = 25600 exactly. Reference Z, Z cuts: local Z = d x Z = (0, 7, 0) is square to Z, so plain mitres; setback 1 1/2 x 7/24 = 7/16" = 448 exact; L = 25 + 7/16 = 25 7/16" = 26048, exact (the splayed bench's leg turned to rake). y = z x d = (168, 0, 49): y.Z > 0 and d.Z > 0, so SW and NE, as the bench's. 2x2 is 1 1/2" square (PS 20-25 Table 3, dry). Label 'Rear leg'.

cutList.label: Front leg
cutList.derivation: Each front leg is 1 1/2" square in the plan and 17" tall: planAxes x = width, y = thickness, length = depth = 17" = 17408 = 1'-5".

cutList.label: Side rail
cuts: Mitre the west end: from 7/8" in along the south edge to the north-west corner (≈16.5° off square).
cutList.derivation: Each side rail is a 16" x 3" x 3/4" board lying on its edge (faceUp north: its local X along world X, its local Y up), flush to its rear leg's inside face, one of the two faces a one-way lean keeps square (angled-parts 3.2). Its back end is cut to the rake: a CornerCut at its south-west corner, 7/8" along the bottom edge and the whole 3" end, 3 x 7/24 = 7/8" = 896 (typed; matching the rake is not kept, #67). The sentence: the whole 3" is the west end, so a mitre of the west end from 7/8" along the south edge to the north-west corner; atan(896/3072) = 16.26 degrees -> 16.5, marked. No stock is named, so no material.
